note: Chippewa NF campground in the Norway Beach Recreation Area on the south shore of Cass Lake, 4 mi east of the town of Cass Lake off US-2, in red and white pines back from the shore, with the loop's own sandy beach and boat ramp; the Norway Beach Visitor Center and the paved Migizi Trail are close by. --Claude
summary: Rec.gov read: 25 nonelectric sites (22 reservable, 3 FCFS; 55-60 ft posted on 140-147), flush/vault toilets, showers, water, no dump (FS), $21, season 05-22..09-08, 2-night weekend minimum. Not waterfront kept (sites 75 m+ back in pine canopy). Pin = catalog centroid. Phone added.
flags: SITES: the FS page says 'No. of Sites 46' (likely the loop including the Norway Beach area totals); the recreation.gov catalog for Wanaki Loop has 25 sites and is used (trust rec.gov).

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept despite rec.gov's 'Some sites have lake views and are near the loop's sandy beach': on Esri imagery the nearest sites (150, 152, 154, 156, 159, 162, 163 along the west side, e.g. 156 at 47.38652,-94.50893) sit 75-90 m from the Cass Lake shore under continuous mature pine canopy, with a shoreline trail between. No catalog site carries a water-proximity attribute. A view through the trunks may exist from the west row; not confirmed by photos, so default down holds.
PIN 47.38691,-94.50831 equals the catalog centroid of the 25 sites; confirmed (recreation.gov's facility point 47.3786,-94.5214 is ~1.3 km SW, ignore).
PHONE: none -> 218-835-4291 (Blackduck Ranger District, on both rec.gov and the FS page). WEBSITE lines confirmed.
